title: Do not grow GM food plants against a moratorium order
what: Cultivate a GM food plant only as any moratorium order the Minister has made allows (or under an exemption).

sources.title: Gene Technology (GM Crop Moratorium) Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 9 (current republication (R5, from 16 December 2025; Gene Technology (GM Crop Moratorium) Act 2004 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if— (a) the person cultivates a GM food plant; and (b) the cultivation is in contravention of a moratorium order

administration.who: Minister administering the Gene Technology (GM Crop Moratorium) Act 2004 (ACT)

sources.title: Gene Technology (GM Crop Moratorium) Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 7, words naming the body (found 20 Nov 2026) (current republication (R5, from 16 December 2025; Gene Technology (GM Crop Moratorium)
sources.quote: The Minister may, in writing, make an order (a moratorium order) prohibiting the cultivation in the ACT of a stated GM food plant.
